The right pie chart titled “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” depicts a two-category split using 2 slices with the category name and percentage placed within each half and no legend; the slices are Disjunctive (very light blue-gray) at 49.51% and Conjunctive (very light lavender) at 50.49%, forming an almost even division with no exploded or highlighted segments.
